# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Follow modern Python and Flask best practices.

Requirements:
- Use Python 3.13 compatible code.
- Keep functions small and reusable.
- Separate game logic from UI logic.
- Write clear comments where necessary.
- Use descriptive variable and function names.
- Include proper error handling.
- Avoid duplicate code.
- Prefer readability over clever solutions.
- Preserve existing functionality while refactoring.
- Write responsive HTML and CSS.
- Support both light and dark mode.
- Keep code modular and easy to test.
- Generate clean, maintainable code.
